verdict: Re-audit of round 87. Of its 8 defects, 7 are closed on arrival and 1 partial: the minimum-breaks headline is qualified and a reversed return leg ships (2(n-2) breaks, measured), the head-to-head table now uses volleyball set points (recomputed: B 5 v A 4), the sit-out credit rounds once, the tie-break order and the reverse leg are each caught by a seeded mutation, and calc.mjs is a 53-line re-export over 15 modules; the README has grown to 6,639 lines. 1029 of 1029 tests pass; 5 of 5 seeded bugs are caught. Four outputs recomputed independently all match. Two small doc gaps (the guide missed the reverse-leg option; a code comment had the odd count wrong) are fixed in this PR with a test. Claims and craft rise to 3, so it meets the bar for the first time; it remains finished.
